title: AetherOS: Autonomous Local AI Operating System Demo (HackMIT Winner)
description: Pitch and live demo of AetherOS at HackMIT 2026. Built with Rust, WASM, and Llama 3.
transcript_text: Good afternoon judges. Today we are presenting AetherOS. Operating systems were built before AI existed. We reimagined the file system as an autonomous semantic memory layer.
